responsibility: This definition file is the top-level declarative inventory for the AArch64 SVE builtin framework. It defines the available mode suffixes, ACLE and ABI vector types, type suffixes and their modes, and then includes the base and SVE2 intrinsic tables, so surrounding code can generate enums, metadata arrays, builtin declarations, overload resolution tables, and type information for the full SVE intrinsic namespace from a single source.
same_name_distinction: In the aarch64-sve-builtins trio, this is the master declarative source that defines SVE modes, vector/type suffix metadata, and includes the base and SVE2 intrinsic tables; unlike the .cc file it is not framework logic, and unlike the .h file it is not the API/type-definition layer.
